title: Cinder Typhoon graduated in-world hints
description: Three-level graduated hints per card. Authored in-world language only. Must not reveal credentials, exact payloads, winning schedules, secrets, or final answers.

hints.description: Map from card ID to three-level hint object.

h1.description: Orientation: points to the relevant system or evidence without naming the technique.

h2.description: Technique class: names the class of boundary or technique to investigate.

h3.description: Concrete next step: a specific diagnostic action that still requires participant work.
